Some of the best selectors djs and producers of Bass Music will be playing. We are not presenting them, because the most important artist is the sound system that we have been building for a couple of years.

Welcome to the STEPPERS SOUND SYSTEM Launch party.
November 8th, at @dar_ziqua in Zaghouan. 

There will be food, bring your drinks and enjoy a day of heavy bass from 12h to 21h, in nature and good vibes.

Contribution 40dt.
